details: Batch for Sat Nov 21 sent, waiting for approval
summary: Of the 35 Trial Reels posted in the last 7 days (Nov 14 to 20), 28 have numbers; 7 show 0 or 1 views in Metricool and are left out. The 28 drew 7,984 views in total, typically about 220 each. The typical 3-second hold is 16%, down from about 23% for the reels of Nov 9 to 13 (pooled by views: 19.2% against 26.7%). In the current test, the author-line opening (O4) is ahead of the number-fact opening (O1) by 2.2 points so far, 20.7% on 709 views against 18.5% on 474, which is too close and too small to call. Best recent reel by hold: Sharh Kashf ash-Shubuhat on Nov 15, 24.9% on 406 views. Worst: Commentary on the Three Fundamental Principles on Nov 14, 6.6% on 116 views. Today's batch is a third day of the same test, O1 against O4, because O1 has not yet reached the 500 views needed to decide it.
change: Two things this morning. The O3 test (the book lands and turns with no line in the first second) is final: O1, the number fact written over the book, stayed champion, 3.9 points ahead (19.9% on 1,462 views against 16.0% on 939), and nothing in the formula changes. The O4 test (the author or explainer line over the book) could not be decided: O1 has only 474 views, under the 500 needed, so it runs a third day today and every later test moves back one day.
